a.lede: The hackers claim they have every agent's name, role, badge number and personal details including home address, phone numbers and spouse information.
a.title: FBI investigates claim by hackers they stole data on all agency staff

b.lede: The theft of agents' personal information could present a major counterintelligence threat, where agents and their families are extorted into cooperating with a foreign government.
b.title: Hacking group ShinyHunters claims it breached the FBI, stole agents’ and applicants’ data
